name: Simple Tablet
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the warrior trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
narrative.objectives: Read the Simple Tablet and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText: You'll find this place fitting as you continue to train in the warrior ways. If you have any questions, feel free to ask anyone around, and when you feel you're ready, come back to me for training. I've mastered as much as any warrior here in the Valley and can pass that knowledge on to you... for a price.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Another troll to bolster the ranks. Good enough for me.

You'll probably have a hard time hefting a good weapon like an axe, but a spear's just as good as anything else.

Welcome to the Valley of Trials.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Simple Tablet
quests.objectiveText: Read the Simple Tablet and speak to Frang in the Valley of Trials.
